display.purpose: High-emphasis project, organization, and authentication headings.

shadows.name: ambient-panel
shadows.purpose: Quiet lift for forms, deletion confirmation, and auth panels.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button, border, and field state transitions.

motion.name: assessment-reveal
motion.purpose: Expanded assessment content entering the reading flow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one clear action in a form or workflow section.
components.css: button.primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 16px; color: #fff; background: #0d7567; border: 1px solid #0d7567; border-radius: 8px; font: 750 0.88rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease; } button.primary:hover { background: #0b4d44; border-color: #0b4d44; } button.primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(13, 117, 103, 0.3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet navigation or supporting action.
components.css: button.secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 16px; color: #0b4d44; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #b4c7c0; border-radius: 8px; font: 750 0.88rem system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease; } button.secondary:hover { background: #f2f8f6; border-color: #0d7567; } button.secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(13, 117, 103, 0.3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A readable white field with an explicit label.
components.css: .field { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 7px; } .field > span { color: #42534d; font: 750 0.78rem/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .field input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 12px; color: #17231f; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #b4c7c0; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 15px/1.65 system-ui, sans-serif; } .field input:focus-visible { border-color: #0d7567; outline: 3px solid rgba(13, 117, 103, 0.3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Function Navigation
components.description: A labeled index that keeps the reader oriented within the CSF Functions.
components.css: .sidebar { display: flex; min-width: 0; height: 100vh; flex-direction: column; padding: 28px 14px 20px; background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid #dbe5e1; } .nav-item { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #61716b; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font: 400 15px/1.65 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .nav-item.active { color: #0b4d44; background: #e7f3ef; border-color: #b8d8ce; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Text-labeled status for project, role, or response state.
components.css: .status-chip { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; padding: 5px 9px; color: #0b4d44; background: #e7f3ef; border-radius: 999px; font: 800 0.68rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; line-height: 1.2; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Assessment Context Rail
components.description: A read-only role-aware brief that frames the central assessment reading column.
components.html:
Read and review the assessment

Use the outcome list to scan coverage and follow up on gaps.
components.css: .assessment-rail { display: grid; gap: 18px; padding: 22px; color: #17231f; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dbe5e1; border-top: 2px solid #0d7567; border-radius: 12px; } .assessment-rail h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 1.2rem/1.18 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .rail-description { margin: 0; color: #42534d; font: 400 0.86rem/1.65 system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The interface treats every assessment as a calm working case file. White reading surfaces hold the content; cool neutral structure separates pages, rails, and states; restrained teal marks the active Function, the next action, and the few statuses that need attention. The system is built for long sessions rather than quick dashboard glances.

rules.name: The Teal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Teal should explain where the reader is or what action is available; it should not fill whole sections without a functional reason.

rules.name: The Flat Workpaper Rule
rules.body: If a border and surface change can establish hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

dos: Do keep compliance copy on white surfaces with a readable measure.
Do make current and target profiles visually distinct and textually labeled.
Do keep Counselor interpretation separate from Stakeholder response/evidence input.
donts: Don't reintroduce gradients, glass effects, decorative illustrations, or dense dashboard chrome.
Don't use color alone to communicate response, coverage, or permission state.
Don't use a monospace or novelty display face as a technical costume.
